summary: Kat's cutoff corrections become a run type on the existing accounting_runs framework: the process check also allows 'cutoff_adjustment'. Kat prepares the correcting entries her cutoff review found; the owner approves each by name in-app. No row changes; nothing posts.

preflight.name: the process check is the migration 511 one (no cutoff_adjustment yet)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'accounting_runs_process_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%bank_reconciliation%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) NOT LIKE '%cutoff_adjustment%'

expected_changes: No accounting run, journal entry, schedule or account changes.

verify.name: cutoff_adjustment is an allowed process; the others still are
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'accounting_runs_process_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%cutoff_adjustment%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%bank_reconciliation%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%interest%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%recognition%'
